store.42: I have known Sarah Chen, the CEO of Pacific Dynamics, for over 15 years. We first met at a Goldman conference in 2008, but our real connection was formed on a delayed flight from Hong Kong six months later. We spent five hours discussing market trends and our shared love of jazz, which laid the foundation for our long-lasting relationship. Now, she is more than just a business contact - she is someone I can call at 3 AM for honest insights about Asian markets. This kind of network is invaluable in our industry.
